messages.subject: Marldale / Crayford - engagement letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Owen,

Please find attached our engagement letter and terms of business for the Crayford matter (our ref WC-00182). If you're happy, please sign the copy and return it.

I've set out a fee estimate for the pre-action phase of £18,000-£25,000 plus VAT. I anticipate we'll want to instruct an independent plant engineer fairly early.

Kind regards

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Litigation
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 5500

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
